title: ACIS functional-cycle path-vector removal fast slice
mode: local implementation and generated in-memory regression
scope: Remove redundant retained cycle-walk indices from rooted ACIS functional-cycle counting
Preserve cycle semantics, graph-link order, and fail-closed output budget behavior

changes.summary: Removed the temporary path vector in countFunctionalCycles. The existing currentPath set supplies the unique visited indices later inserted into completed. Reduced output-item accounting from two items to one for each currentPath insertion; completed-set accounting is unchanged.

Added an in-memory body with two owner-linked lumps in a next-list cycle. Exact generated projection passes at 33 output items with unchanged reachable indices and graph-link rows and one reported cycle; a 32-item budget refuses with ResourceLimit and clears output.

evidence.redGreen: The new 33-item semantic regression failed against the old implementation and passed after removing the redundant path vector.

limitations.reasonUncommitted: The shared worktree contains broad pre-existing changes, including extensive modifications to the same source and test files; staging or committing them together is unsafe.
